feedback_by_option.fil: Mahalaga ito, pero unahin kung sino ang nasa panganib ngayon.
feedback_by_option.en: It matters, but first ask who is in danger right now.

feedback_by_option.fil: Una ang ligtas na paglikas; saka ipapasa ang bawat isyu sa kumpirmadong lead na may follow-up.
feedback_by_option.en: Safe evacuation comes first; then each issue goes to a confirmed lead with follow-up.

feedback_by_option.fil: Dapat magpahinga at humingi ng suporta ang responder kung hindi ligtas magpatuloy.
feedback_by_option.en: A responder should rest and seek support when it is unsafe to continue.

feedback_by_option.fil: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: kailangan ng follow-up ang volunteer at ang referral.
feedback_by_option.en: This may harm or delay help: the volunteer and the referral both need follow-up.

feedback_by_option.fil: Sa naitalang pagtanggap at follow-up, may may-ari ang bawat isyu, kasama ang pag-aalaga sa responder.
feedback_by_option.en: Recorded acknowledgement and follow-up keep every issue owned, including responder care.

feedback_by_option.fil: Kumpirmahin ang lahat ng contact at ruta bago gamitin.
feedback_by_option.en: Verify every contact and route before use.
